summary.notes: Beanstalk diamond (EIP-2535). Primary attack surface clusters: (1) L1->L2 reseed/migration facets that bulk-write global silo/field/stalk accounting with no per-account guards, (2) the oracle TWAP/spot path feeding sunrise mint and convert economics, (3) the permissionless redeem migration path lacking replay protection, (4) Tractor/Pipeline/Farm arbitrary-call execution that can reenter the diamond. Reseed init() functions are external with no access modifier and depend entirely on diamondCut wiring (ACCESS-001).

functions.why: Permissionless entry. Verifies merkle proof + EIP-712 sig but stores no spent-marker; setStalk uses += (DT-003). Merkle leaf omits reciever (DT-010). Sits at head of dangerous chain CH-001. Unbacked stalk/roots minting.

ite_hypothesis.intent: Inflate s.accts[reciever].stalk/roots and credit silo deposits to an attacker-chosen address without backing
ite_hypothesis.technique: Replay observed public calldata (proof+signature) before deadline; setStalk += accumulates each call; reciever bound only by signature, not by merkle leaf, so credit can be redirected
ite_hypothesis.evasion: No nonce / redeemed-marker stored. MerkleProof.verify and ECDSA.recover pass identically on each replay. Conservative reading: unbounded replay within deadline window -> potentially Critical

functions.why: Reachable via redeem. Declares totalDeposited/totalDepositedBdv but never increments them in loop, then writes 0 to s.sys.silo.balances[token] global totals (DT-002, ACC-002). Breaks total==sum(accounts).

ite_hypothesis.intent: Corrupt global per-token silo balances to 0 while per-account deposits exist, desyncing withdraw/convert/BDV math
ite_hypothesis.technique: Accumulator vars never written; assignment of 0 to global state overwrites protocol-wide totals
ite_hypothesis.evasion: No guard recomputes global totals; downstream withdraw underflow / DoS or value inflation

functions.why: Computes merkle leaf = keccak256(account,deposits,internalBalances,ownerRoots) — does NOT commit to reciever (DT-010, CC-001). Enables credit redirection given a public signature.

ite_hypothesis.intent: Bind migration credit to a specific reciever
ite_hypothesis.technique: reciever omitted from leaf; only EIP-712 sig over (owner,reciever,deadline) binds it
ite_hypothesis.evasion: Use on-chain-visible signature to redeem to a chosen reciever; compounds DT-003 replay

functions.why: Bridge-gated (msg.sender==BRIDGE && xDomainMessageSender==L1BEANSTALK) but EXTERNAL_L1_BEANS hardcoded to 0 so require(0 >= migratedL1Beans+amount) reverts for any amount>0 (DT-005, ACC-004, CH-004). L1 Beans burned before this; permanent fund loss.

ite_hypothesis.intent: Remint externally-held L1 Beans on L2 up to migratable supply
ite_hypothesis.technique: Cap constant left at 0 placeholder makes the post-increment require always fail
ite_hypothesis.evasion: No attacker needed; honest migrant loses L1 Beans (burned) with L2 mint always reverting -> direct loss / migration DoS

functions.why: External, no access modifier (ACCESS-001). Calls reseedSiloDeposit per token; reseedSiloDeposit sets s.accts[account].stalk = accountStalk (=, not +=) so multi-token holders' stalk overwritten by last token (DT-001, ACC-001). Global s.sys.silo.stalk never reconciled to sum (DT-009, ACC-010). CH-002.

ite_hypothesis.intent: Preserve each account's summed stalk and the global total across L1->L2 reseed
ite_hypothesis.technique: Per-token assignment overwrites prior tokens' stalk; no global-total accumulation
ite_hypothesis.evasion: Bug self-triggers on every multi-token holder; if init is exposed as a callable facet selector rather than one-shot delegatecall, anyone could re-run it

functions.why: External, no access modifier. Inner plot loop header increments outer index i instead of inner j (DT-004, STATE-001, CH-003) -> OOB revert. Field reseed cannot complete; pods cannot migrate.

ite_hypothesis.intent: Assign each account its plots exactly once and tally pods
ite_hypothesis.technique: Loop post-statement increments wrong variable (i not j) -> accountPlots[i] OOB
ite_hypothesis.evasion: Deterministic; reverts on first account with plots -> migration DoS

functions.why: External, no access modifier. setInternalBalances iterates farmers.length reading balances[i] without length-equality check (DT-011) -> OOB revert on mismatched input.

ite_hypothesis.intent: Credit each farmer its internal balance
ite_hypothesis.evasion: Bounded by sum guard; reseed step reverts on bad upgrade input

functions.why: External, no access modifier. mintFertilizers builds nextFid linked list assuming ascending IDs, enforced only in NatSpec not code (DT-012). Out-of-order input -> malformed/cyclic list -> Sun payout iteration corruption.

ite_hypothesis.intent: Form a correct ascending fertilizer linked list
ite_hypothesis.technique: Ordering enforced by comment only, no require
ite_hypothesis.evasion: Bounded by trusted upgrade input; mispaid/stranded fertilizer if violated

functions.why: Inverted ternary: lookback>0 returns spot getPrice, lookback==0 calls getTwap(...,0) dividing by zero (DT-006, ARITH-001). Feeds sunrise mint and convert via CH-005. Manipulation-resistant TWAP requests silently get manipulable spot.

ite_hypothesis.intent: Cause a mint/convert/peg path expecting a TWAP to consume a flash-loan-manipulable spot price
ite_hypothesis.technique: Request a lookback>0 path; receive spot; skew spot via flash loan within one block -> mispriced Bean issuance/conversion
ite_hypothesis.evasion: Inverted branch defeats the only manipulation guard; requires confirming a reachable financial consumer (LibWellMinting/LibDeltaB)

functions.why: encodeType 0x01 does 1e24/getTokenPrice with no zero-check (DT-007, ARITH-003) -> revert/DoS on frozen feed. Custom-oracle branch decodes staticcall returndata via raw assembly mload, no length check (DT-008, CC-003). CH-005, CH-008.

ite_hypothesis.intent: Inject an arbitrary price into peg/minting, or DoS season advancement on feed outage
ite_hypothesis.technique: Frozen feed returns 0 -> 1e24/0 reverts; or registered custom oracle returns <32 bytes / attacker-influenced data -> arbitrary tokenPrice
ite_hypothesis.evasion: Documented 0-sentinel contract violated; custom-oracle path bounded by admin registration trust

functions.why: Operator executes a signed blueprint's AdvancedFarmCall[] as the publisher (LibTractor._user() == activePublisher). Blueprint nonce/maxNonce (STATE-002) and activePublisher reset on revert (STATE-004) are the only guards. CH-007 marks reentrancy_surface true.

ite_hypothesis.intent: Replay a signed blueprint beyond maxNonce, or leave activePublisher set to act as another user
ite_hypothesis.technique: If nonce check is off-by-one/missing, re-run blueprint to drain publisher allowances; if reset is not on the revert path, a stuck activePublisher leaks delegated context to a later caller
ite_hypothesis.evasion: verifyRequisition checks signature; runBlueprint manages publisher set/reset — trace whether reset is finally-equivalent

functions.why: Permissionless. Executes user-supplied Pipeline advancedPipe (arbitrary external calls) then recomputes convert BDV/stalk against well reserves (CH-006, ARITH-004, CC-004). reentrancy_surface true. Mispriced convert could mint BDV/stalk.

ite_hypothesis.intent: Mint unbacked BDV/stalk by manipulating well reserves mid-convert or reentering the diamond while balances are mid-update
ite_hypothesis.technique: Use Pipeline arbitrary calls to skew well reserves between cache and recompute, or cross-facet reenter during a window where silo invariants are temporarily false
ite_hypothesis.evasion: nonReentrant may be scoped per-facet only; convert BDV-preservation check is the guard — verify it reads post-manipulation reserves

functions.why: Permissionless convert; caches pipeline convert state and validates against LibConvert. BDV/stalk preservation (ARITH-004) is the core invariant; reads well/oracle reserves.

ite_hypothesis.intent: Inflate stalk/BDV via a favorable-looking convert that is actually mispriced
ite_hypothesis.technique: Manipulate the reserve/oracle source used to value bdvOut vs bdvIn within a single tx
ite_hypothesis.evasion: noSupplyChange + BDV check; verify the price source is manipulation-resistant (ties to ARITH-001 oracle bug)

functions.why: Permissionless season advance; stepOracle -> deltaB -> Bean mint. Reward Beans minted to caller. If deltaB reads instantaneous reserves (via inverted-TWAP bug) the mint is flash-loan manipulable (CC-005, CH-005).

ite_hypothesis.intent: Manipulate the sunrise Bean mint amount or the caller reward via reserve skew
ite_hypothesis.technique: Flash-loan-skew well reserves before calling sunrise so stepOracle deltaB over-mints
ite_hypothesis.evasion: Mint should use cumulative pump TWAP not spot; ARITH-001 inversion is the gap to confirm in the mint path

functions.why: Permissionless, sends tokens out. Reads s.sys.silo.balances[token] global totals corrupted to 0 by ACC-002 — withdrawal underflow / DoS or inflation downstream of the migration bug.

ite_hypothesis.intent: Underflow or over-withdraw against desynced global silo balances post-migration
ite_hypothesis.technique: After ACC-002 zeroes global totals, a withdraw that decrements global balance underflows (DoS) or accounting permits over-withdrawal
ite_hypothesis.evasion: nonReentrant present; the gap is upstream accounting desync, not the guard

functions.why: Permissionless deposit transfer with allowance (LibSiloPermit). Mows both sender and recipient; stalk/seeds move. Check allowance/permit and stalk-conservation across transfer.

ite_hypothesis.intent: Move deposits/stalk without sufficient allowance, or break stalk conservation across the transfer
ite_hypothesis.technique: Exploit permit nonce reuse or mow ordering to mismatch seeds/stalk between sender and recipient
ite_hypothesis.evasion: _spendDepositAllowance + dual mow; verify permit replay (LibSiloPermit) and conservation

functions.why: Permissionless EIP-2612-style permit for deposit allowances (LibSiloPermit). Signature/nonce/deadline/chainId handling is the classic replay surface.

ite_hypothesis.intent: Replay a permit signature to grant deposit allowance the owner did not re-authorize
ite_hypothesis.technique: Missing chainId in domain, nonce not incremented, or sig malleability lets the same permit be reused
ite_hypothesis.evasion: depositPermitNonces + domain separator; verify nonce increment, deadline, and chainId binding

functions.why: Permissionless arbitrary external-call execution (Pipeline). Sends ETH/tokens. CC-004 cross-facet reentrancy concern; Pipeline._pipeMem flagged High by static. Reentry vector into silo/field state.

ite_hypothesis.intent: Reenter Beanstalk facets mid-operation, or use the diamond as a caller to bypass per-call trust assumptions
ite_hypothesis.technique: Craft a PipeCall whose target calls back into a convert/withdraw facet while invariants are temporarily false
ite_hypothesis.evasion: No nonReentrant on pipe entry points observed; verify whether per-facet guards cover cross-facet reentry

functions.why: Permissionless batched delegatecall into Beanstalk facets; composes multiple state mutations atomically. Reentrancy/ordering surface combined with Pipeline and Tractor (CH-006/CH-007).

ite_hypothesis.intent: Compose facet calls in an order that violates an invariant a single-call guard assumes
ite_hypothesis.technique: Batch deposit+convert+withdraw within one farm() to exploit a window where mow/stalk is stale
ite_hypothesis.evasion: Individual facets carry nonReentrant; verify the batch cannot interleave state in an unguarded way

agent_hints.reentrancy: Focus on: PipelineConvertFacet.pipelineConvert(), DepotFacet.advancedPipe()/pipe(), FarmFacet.farm(), TractorFacet.tractor() — all execute arbitrary/batched external calls; check cross-facet reentrancy (CC-004) where nonReentrant may be scoped per-facet only and silo/field invariants are temporarily false.
agent_hints.access_control: Focus on: L2ContractMigrationFacet.redeemDepositsAndInternalBalances() (no replay marker, reciever not in merkle leaf), Reseed*.init() (external, no access modifier — confirm diamondCut one-shot wiring, ACCESS-001), TractorFacet.tractor() (publisher impersonation via activePublisher reset), ApprovalFacet.permitDeposits() (permit replay/chainId).
agent_hints.arithmetic: Focus on: L2ContractMigrationFacet.addMigratedDepositsToAccount() (uninitialized totalDeposited/Bdv written as 0, ACC-002), ReseedSilo.reseedSiloDeposit() (= vs += stalk overwrite, ACC-001/ACC-010), LibUsdOracle.getTokenPriceFromExternal() (1e24/0 div, ARITH-003), LibConvert BDV preservation (ARITH-004).
agent_hints.oracle: Focus on: LibChainlinkOracle.getTokenPrice() (inverted TWAP/spot ternary, ARITH-001), LibUsdOracle.getTokenPriceFromExternal() (unchecked staticcall mload + div-by-zero), trace to LibWellMinting.capture/LibDeltaB feeding sunrise mint (CC-005, CH-005).
agent_hints.flash_loan: Focus on: SeasonFacet.sunrise()/gm() and ConvertFacet.convert()/PipelineConvertFacet.pipelineConvert() — confirm whether deltaB/convert valuation reads manipulable spot (via ARITH-001 bug) so a single-tx reserve skew mints Beans or unbacked BDV/stalk.
agent_hints.logic: Focus on: ReseedSilo.reseedSiloDeposit() (= overwrite), ReseedField.init() (i-vs-j loop, STATE-001), BeanL1RecieverFacet.recieveL1Beans() (EXTERNAL_L1_BEANS=0 cap, ACC-004), L2ContractMigrationFacet redeem chain (replay+redirect), ReseedBarn.mintFertilizers() (unsorted-id linked list).
agent_hints.dos: Focus on: ReseedField.init() (OOB revert bricks Field migration), ReseedInternalBalances.setInternalBalances() (no length check), LibUsdOracle div-by-zero on frozen feed, SiloFacet.withdrawDeposit() (underflow against ACC-002-zeroed global totals).
agent_hints.economic_attack: Focus on: SeasonFacet.sunrise() (mint manipulation + caller reward), PipelineConvertFacet.pipelineConvert()/ConvertFacet.convert() (BDV/stalk inflation), L2ContractMigrationFacet.redeemDepositsAndInternalBalances() (unbacked governance weight + earned-Bean share via replay).
agent_hints.cross_chain: Focus on: BeanL1RecieverFacet.recieveL1Beans() and BeanL2MigrationFacet.migrateL2Beans() — L1 burn precedes L2 mint; the EXTERNAL_L1_BEANS=0 cap makes every L2 mint revert after the burn (CH-004). Verify bridge sender gating and message replay.
agent_hints.logic_migration: Focus on: entire L2ContractMigrationFacet + Reseed* set — bulk accounting writes (stalk, deposits, roots, pods, fertilizer, internal balances) with per-token/per-account loops and weak input validation.
agent_hints.behavioral_state_analysis: Focus on: ReseedBarn.mintFertilizers() (ascending-id requirement stated only in NatSpec, not enforced) and BeanL1RecieverFacet (NatSpec says 'migrates Beans to L2' but cap=0 makes it always revert) — documented-but-not-enforced behavior.
agent_hints.semantic_guard: Focus on: Reseed*.init() asymmetric guarding (external, no modifier) vs the guarded user facets; confirm whether init selectors are reachable post-upgrade.
agent_hints.token_integration: Focus on: SiloFacet deposit/withdraw LibTransfer.receiveToken/sendToken modes and unripe tokens; convert valuation across non-standard whitelisted tokens.
agent_hints.snapshot: Focus on: stalk/roots as governance vote weight — ACC-001/ACC-003/ACC-010 corruptions directly mis-scale voting power and quorum.
